checked_scope: The variance identity, simple-random-sampling specialization, cluster counterexample and local-transport proviso.
checks: Independence of the whole sampling and score vectors gives Cov(IiZi/pii,IjZj/pij)=ratio*Cov(Zi,Zj)+(ratio-1)mui*muj. Marginal independence alone would not justify it.
SRS diagonal ratio N/n and off-diagonal ratio N(n-1)/(n(N-1)) give normalized absolute sampling sum 2(N-n)/(nN), including zero at census.

Cluster signs yield exact variance 1/n+(n-1)d/[n(N-1)], equal to (d+1)/N at census. Sampling a whole deterministic half-population yields variance 1/4. The local transport inequality requires the same Lipschitz response map and approximation error; long-cycle connectedness violates that locality.
